build_cascade_mask_rcnn_resnest50: build a cascade mask R-CNN model with ResNeSt-50 backbone and SyncBN normalization for COCO instance segmentation
configure_resnest_backbone: configure a ResNeSt-50 backbone with radix=2, reduction_factor=4, and FPN multi-scale feature pyramid
setup_syncbn_roi_head: setup a cascade R-CNN ROI head with three Shared4Conv1FCBBoxHead stages and SyncBN mask head
create_train_pipeline_coco: create a COCO training pipeline with multi-scale random resize, random flip, and bounding box plus mask annotations
run_mask_rcnn_training: run cascade mask R-CNN training on COCO with ResNeSt-50 pretrained weights and multi-scale augmentation
